symptom: describe javascript action shows the EXTRA CODE only as a comment; re-running `create or modify` with an edited body overwrote a hand-restored .js, deleting the EXTRA CODE helpers and the import list the user code calls
cause: WriteJavaScriptSourceFile regenerated the file from the statement alone: GenerateJavaScriptSource had no slot for imports or extra code, unlike the Java twin (RetainSections, #705). The #731 fix only left the file alone when the body was unchanged
insight: When one doctype's file writer gains retention, grep for its twin: the Java fix (#705) landed long before the JS one with the same shape. Retain in the backend writer, next to the file read, so no interface change is needed and every caller is covered. JS imports can span lines and omit semicolons, and marketplace bundles put them above the banner, so scan statements up to the EXTRA CODE marker rather than matching single `import ...;` lines. The control is reverting only the writer: the test then loses every import and the helper.
